effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Main Phase] If there are 2 or more Digimon in play, gain 1 memory.
[All Turns] When you would play 1 Digimon card with the [Blue Flare] trait or [Twilight] trait with DigiXros requirements, by suspending this Tamer, you may place 1 card from under your Tamers and 1 card from your trash as digivolution cards for a DigiXros.
